title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Schedule of Sale and Journey Windows
content:
Tariffs and Distribution publishes, for each of the seven Air Ticket Fare Brands, the distances and windows that govern when a brand may be sold and how long a journey sold under it may run.

## 1. The quantities scheduled

1.1 The advance-purchase distance is the minimum number of calendar days between booking and departure for the brand to be sold.
1.2 The minimum stay is the number of nights that must fall between the outbound and the return.
1.3 The maximum stay is the greatest number of calendar days after the outbound departure on which the return may fall.
1.4 The hold window is the number of whole hours an unticketed hold may stand before it is released.
1.5 The group threshold is the number of travellers on one booking from which group terms replace the brand's terms.
1.6 The ticket validity term is the number of calendar months a ticket stays valid for travel from the date of issue.

## 2. Schedule by brand

| Fare brand | Advance purchase (days) | Minimum stay (nights) | Maximum stay (days) | Hold window (hours) | Group threshold (travellers) | Ticket validity (months) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 21 | 3 | 30 | 0 | 10 | 12 |
| Economy Saver | 14 | 2 | 90 | 0 | 10 | 12 |
| Economy Classic | 7 | 1 | 180 | 24 | 10 | 12 |
| Economy Flex | 3 | 0 | 330 | 24 | 9 | 12 |
| Premium Economy Select | 3 | 0 | 330 | 48 | 9 | 12 |
| Business Saver | 1 | 0 | 330 | 48 | 7 | 12 |
| Business Flex | 0 | 0 | 365 | 72 | 7 | 12 |

## 3. Notes distinguishing the brands

3.1 Two brands schedule a hold window of 0 hours, Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver; on those two nothing stands unticketed.
3.2 The minimum stay falls away from Economy Flex upwards, where it is scheduled at 0 nights.
3.3 The group threshold is scheduled at 10 travellers on the three lowest brands, at 9 on Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select, and at 7 on the two Business brands.
3.4 The ticket validity term is scheduled at 12 months on every brand, so it never distinguishes one from another.

## 4. Worked selection, on hypothetical figures

A hypothetical enquiry seeks a journey departing in 5 days and returning 200 days later. Read off this schedule alone: the advance-purchase distances of 21, 14 and 7 days exclude Basic Economy Lite, Economy Saver and Economy Classic; of the remainder the maximum stays of 330 and 365 days all accommodate a 200-day journey, and the minimum stays of 0 nights are all satisfied. The brands this schedule leaves available are therefore Economy Flex, Premium Economy Select, Business Saver and Business Flex.
